start.title: [TODO:es] A Visit by Night
start.text:
[TODO:es] Nicodemus comes quietly under the stars.
He seeks Jesus while the city sleeps.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Seek Truth
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Even by night, the honest seeker is welcome.
Draw near in peace.

greet.title: [TODO:es] Rabbi from God
greet.text:
[TODO:es] "Rabbi, we know you come from God,"
Nicodemus says with quiet respect.

flatter_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Be Sincere
flatter_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He sees the heart, not smooth words.
Come plainly to him.

born_again.title: [TODO:es] Born Again
born_again.text:
[TODO:es] Jesus says softly,
"You must be born again to see the kingdom."

dismiss_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay Open
dismiss_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] What sounds impossible may be Spirit.
Ask and you will learn.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Be Humble
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Wisdom hides from a scornful heart.
Soften and try again.

spirit.title: [TODO:es] Like the Wind
spirit.text:
[TODO:es] "The Spirit is like the wind," Jesus breathes.
"You hear it, but cannot trace it."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Some truths are felt, not seen.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Faith First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The wind moves leaves you cannot grasp.
Trust still moves the soul.

heavenly.title: [TODO:es] Heavenly Things
heavenly.text:
[TODO:es] "If earthly words confuse you,
how will heavenly ones be received?"

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Be Still
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Even teachers must sit and learn.
Let his words settle.

love.title: [TODO:es] So Loved the World
love.text:
[TODO:es] "God so loved the world he gave his Son,
that whoever believes may have life."

reject_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Open Your Heart
reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His love is offered freely to you.
Receive it gently.

light.title: [TODO:es] Step into Light
light.text:
[TODO:es] "Whoever lives by truth comes to the light,
so his deeds may shine."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The light is kinder than fear.

hide2_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Come Forward
hide2_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Hiding wears the heart down.
Let the light find you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You let the light reach you.

reflect.title: [TODO:es] Walking Home
reflect.text:
[TODO:es] Nicodemus walks home as dawn rises,
the words burning quietly inside.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Carry his words in your heart

forget_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Keep Watch
forget_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Some seeds grow slowly in the soul.
Do not lose them.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Carry his words in your heart

ending.title: [TODO:es] Born of the Spirit
ending.text:
[TODO:es] Jesus stands in the morning light.
"Be born of the Spirit, and live."
